mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is derived from the month-over-month change in FEDFUNDS.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where FEDFUNDS declined month-over-month are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.5 percentage points over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes a decline in equity valuations. This predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in periods where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5pp over 3 months are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A real interest rate (FEDFUNDS minus CPIAUCSL) exceeding 2.0% over the past month signals a tightening monetary policy, which is associated with negative equity returns. The signal is active when the real rate exceeds 2.0%.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods where the real rate (FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.0% are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, a sustained growth in real GDP (GDPC1) above 2.0% annually signals strong economic momentum, which typically leads to positive equity returns as corporate earnings grow. The signal is active when GDP growth exceeds 2.0% annually.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where GDP growth exceeds 2.0% annually are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month indicates strengthening economic activity, which compresses discount rates and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is derived from the month-over-month change in INDPRO.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where INDPRO rose month-over-month are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 500 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, which typically precedes a decline in equity valuations. This predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in periods where HOUST falls below 500 thousand units are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increasing unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with a declining labor force (PAYEMS) signals a deteriorating labor market, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal is active when UNRATE rises by more than 0.2 percentage points and PAYEMS falls by more than 100 thousand persons over a 3-month window.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and PAYEMS falls > 100k in 3 months
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods where UNRATE rises by more than 0.2pp and PAYEMS falls by more than 100k over 3 months are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market recovery, a rising residential sales (RSAFS) above 350,000 units predicts positive equity returns as housing market strength supports consumer spending and corporate earnings. The signal is active when RSAFS exceeds 350,000 units.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where RSAFS exceeds 350,000 units are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
